messages:
marta (Finance Ops): FYI noticed a batch problem in March generation. Two issues: 1) acct_acme received two invoices, one missing the reserved-capacity prorate line; 2) Contour (acct_ctr) had the same vendor credit applied twice. Anyone seeing this in logs?

oliver (Billing Eng): Can you paste the invoice ids and a small ledger export? I'll start by scanning the billing-engine writes. tagging @liam for ETL timing.

marta (Finance Ops): inv_2034_0301_acme and inv_2034_0301_acme-copy (weird suffix). Contour invoice inv_2034_0301_ctr. Export snippet: 
```json
{"account":"acct_acme","invoice_id":"inv_2034_0301_acme","lines":[],"credits":[{"code":"vendor_credit_v55","amount":-500}],"total_cents":-500}
```

oliver (Billing Eng): Empty lines array is suspicious. I see a recent change that drops zero-usage prorations earlier in the pipeline. If the writer retried after the filter ran it could have created two invoice records. I'll check DB write ids and batch UUIDs.

liam (Data Eng): I queried ETL logs for 2025-03-01 00:10-00:20 UTC. There was a run where the exporter logged: `INFO billing_exporter: omitted prorated line - usage_amount=0` then a transient DB error and a retry that reprocessed the same batch UUID. That matches duplicate invoice creation + missing line. Re-running the extract for affected accounts now.

tara (CS): Customer already opened a ticket — they attached both PDFs and flagged missing line. Can we stop auto-collections for acct_acme until corrected? Need note for CS to send.

oliver (Billing Eng): Agreed pause. I'll create a reversal and regenerate corrected invoice once we confirm the re-run. But to be safe I want to void the spurious invoice record (inv_2034_0301_acme-copy) before payment processing. Need finance sign-off to void and issue correction.

marta (Finance Ops): Approve voiding the duplicate. Please include a brief cover note in the regenerated PDF explaining the correction and mark the account for manual review this cycle.

deploy-bot: RELEASE: billing-engine v3.7.2 deployed 2025-03-01T00:09:58Z — contains PR #688 `filter-empty-prorated-lines`. Potentially related.

oliver (Billing Eng): Opening rollback PR to revert the filter until we add idempotency on DB writes and improve retry semantics. Will also add a regression test for zero-usage prorate + transient write failure.

liam (Data Eng): Re-run done for acct_acme and acct_ctr. Confirmed original prorate row exists in raw extract. I pushed a manual ingest replacement for accts and flagged the batch metadata to prevent double-write.

oliver (Billing Eng): Done: voided inv_2034_0301_acme-copy (credit issued) and regenerated corrected PDFs for both ACME and Contour. Uploaded to S3 path `s3://invoices/2025/03/01/{account}/inv_2034_0301_corrected.pdf`. Notified CS.

tara (CS): Got it — updating the customer ticket and pausing dunning for acct_acme. Thanks team. ETA to customer: updated PDF + explanation in next 2 hours.

marta (Finance Ops): Thanks everyone — follow-up items: (1) oliver to merge rollback and add idempotent write test; (2) liam to add an alert for exporter retries + skipped-lines anomaly; (3) finance to review cover note template. Target: prevent recurrence next cycle.
